name: 3D Block World
description: A world of 1 metre blocks you walk through in first person, with W A S D.
_why_note: The owner's test05 (2026-10-04): asked for 'a simple, block 3D game ... made by 1 meter square cubes', Gary Fast gave one window-sized rectangle, and the Games prompt itself told Gary to build 'the closest 2D version'. A first-person renderer is more than a small model can write through edit_file, and it is ~200 lines of plain pygame Open Nest can ship and test -- the same reasoning as every starter: the foundation is files on disk, and what Gary is for is changing it. Everything a child would change is a named value at the top: WORLD (the map, one letter a block), BLOCKS, SKY, GROUND, STARS, PLANETS, HANDS, the speeds. benchmarks/game_builds, SPIKES.md section 33.
